chapters.title: Manifests & Configurations (TOML)
chapters.description: Master Solana's build manifests, workspace configs, compiler flags, and toolchain TOMLs.

chapters.title: CI/CD & Build Infrastructure
chapters.description: GitHub Actions workflows, Buildkite pipelines, SBF toolchains, and CI automation scripts.

chapters.title: Solana SDK & Core Primitives
chapters.description: Pubkey, Signature, Instruction, Transaction, Account, and fee calculation primitives.

chapters.title: Proof of History & Ledger Pipeline
chapters.description: Verifiable delay cryptography, tick recording, entries, shreds, and blockstore storage.

chapters.title: Solana Virtual Machine (SVM)
chapters.description: High-throughput transaction execution engine, invoke contexts, compute meters, and BPF syscalls.

chapters.title: AccountsDB & Memory Engine
chapters.description: High-concurrency append-vec storage, bucket index maps, bank hash verification, and snapshots.

chapters.title: Consensus, Voting & Validator
chapters.description: Validator node startup, banking stage, replay loop, leader schedule, and consensus voting.

chapters.title: Networking, Turbine & Streamer
chapters.description: Gossip cluster protocol, tree-based shred distribution (Turbine), and QUIC transport streaming.

chapters.title: RPC, Client SDKs & Tooling
chapters.description: JSON-RPC endpoints, banks-client test harness, keygen, ledger exploration, and CLI tools.

chapters.title: Native Programs & Cryptography
chapters.description: On-chain system/stake programs, zero-knowledge proofs (zk-token-sdk), and BLS signature verification.

chapters.title: System Utilities & Platform Crates
chapters.description: Memory managers, thread limiters, eBPF XDP drivers, loggers, and metrics collection.

lessons.title: clippy.toml Configuration
lessons.description: Configuration definitions and dependencies from clippy.toml
lessons.code:
too-many-arguments-threshold = 9

disallowed-methods = [
    { path = "std::net::UdpSocket::bind", reason = "Use solana_net_utils::bind_with_config, bind_to, etc instead for proper socket configuration." },
    { path = "tokio::net::UdpSocket::bind", reason = "Use solana_net_utils::bind_to_async or bind_to_with_config_non_blocking instead for proper socket configuration." },
    { path = "lazy_static::initialize", reason = "Deprecated. Use std::{cell::{LazyCell, OnceCell}, sync::{LazyLock, OnceLock}} as appropriate." },
]

disallowed-macros = [
    { path = "solana_sdk::saturating_add_assign", reason = "Deprecated. Use std::num::Saturating<T> instead." },
    { path = "lazy_static::lazy_static", reason = "Deprecated. Use std::{cell::{LazyCell, OnceCell}, sync::{LazyLock, OnceLock}} as appropriate." },
    { path = "assert_matches::assert_matches", reason = "Use std::assert_matches! instead." },
    { path = "assert_matches::debug_assert_matches", reason = "Use std::debug_assert_matches! instead." },
]

upload-ci-artifact() {
  echo "--- artifact: $1"
  if [[ -r "$1" ]]; then
    ls -l "$1"
    if ${BUILDKITE:-false}; then
      (
        set -x
        buildkite-agent artifact upload "$1"
      )
    fi
  else
    echo ^^^ +++
    echo "$1 not found"
  fi
}

lessons.description: Continuous integration and build step from scripts/read-cargo-variable.sh
lessons.code:
readCargoVariable() {
  declare variable="$1"
  declare Cargo_toml="$2"

  while read -r name equals value _; do
    if [[ $name = "$variable" && $equals = = ]]; then
      echo "${value//\"/}"
      return
    fi
  done < <(cat "$Cargo_toml")
  echo "Unable to locate $variable in $Cargo_toml" 1>&2
}

lessons.code:
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct TransactionCost {
    pub signature_cost: u64,
    pub write_lock_cost: u64,
    pub data_bytes_cost: u16,
    pub programs_execution_cost: u64,
    pub loaded_accounts_data_size_cost: u64,
    pub allocated_accounts_data_size: u64,
}

impl TransactionCost {
    pub fn sum(&self) -> u64 {
        self.signature_cost
            .saturating_add(self.write_lock_cost)
            .saturating_add(u64::from(self.data_bytes_cost))
            .saturating_add(self.programs_execution_cost)
            .saturating_add(self.loaded_accounts_data_size_cost)
    }

use crate::{crds_data::CrdsData, crds_value::CrdsValue};

#[inline]
#[must_use]
pub(crate) fn should_retain_crds_value(value: &CrdsValue) -> bool {
    match value.data() {
        CrdsData::ContactInfo(_) => true,
        CrdsData::SnapshotHashes(_) => true,
        CrdsData::DuplicateShred(_, _) | CrdsData::EpochSlots(_) => false,
        CrdsData::AccountsHashes(_) | CrdsData::Vote(_) => false,
        CrdsData::LegacyContactInfo(_) => false,
        CrdsData::LegacySnapshotHashes(_) => false,
        CrdsData::LegacyVersion(_) => false,
        CrdsData::LowestSlot(_) => false,
        CrdsData::NodeInstance(_) => false,
        CrdsData::RestartHeaviestFork(_) | CrdsData::RestartLastVotedForkSlots(_) => false,
        CrdsData::Version(_) => false,
    }

pub fn transaction_error_to_not_included_reason(
    error: &TransactionError,
    all_or_nothing: bool,
) -> u8 {
    match error {
        TransactionError::AccountInUse => not_included_reasons::ACCOUNT_IN_USE,
        TransactionError::AccountLoadedTwice => not_included_reasons::ACCOUNT_LOADED_TWICE,
        TransactionError::AccountNotFound => not_included_reasons::ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND,
        TransactionError::ProgramAccountNotFound => not_included_reasons::PROGRAM_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND,
        TransactionError::InsufficientFundsForFee => {
            not_included_reasons::INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS_FOR_FEE
        }
        TransactionError::InvalidAccountForFee => not_included_reasons::INVALID_ACCOUNT_FOR_FEE,
        TransactionError::AlreadyProcessed => not_included_reasons::ALREADY_PROCESSED,
        TransactionError::BlockhashNotFound => not_included_reasons::BLOCKHASH_NOT_FOUND,
        TransactionError::InstructionError(_, _) => not_included_reasons::INSTRUCTION_ERROR,
        TransactionError::CallChainTooDeep => not_included_reasons::CALL_CHAIN_TOO_DEEP,
        TransactionError::MissingSignatureForFee => not_included_reasons::MISSING_SIGNATURE_FOR_FEE,
        TransactionError::InvalidAccountIndex => not_included_reasons::INVALID_ACCOUNT_INDEX,
